The '''Hanna Institute of Antiquities''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] and [[University/Legends|university]] located in [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]].

==Description==
The Hanna Institute of Antiquities was located in Hanna City on Chandrila and was dedicated to the study and preservation of the galaxy's ancient past. Professors at the Institute would lead their students on excisions of archaeological study, bringing back artifacts to be studied and displayed in the Institute's showcases.<ref name="SoR" /> In the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], it sponsored studies on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]].

The Institute consisted of several public galleries, with exhibits dedicated to Chandrilan history, the [[Ringali Shell]], and the greater galaxy. Over time, the Institute featured artifacts and displays of [[Xim/Legends|Xim the Despot]], the [[Pius Dea Crusades]], [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]], and various [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]]. On 14:5:2 [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it hosted the "[[Cradle of the Galaxy]]" exhibit. After the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the Institute housed an exhibit "[[The Courage of Palpatine]]," which was the worst attended in history.<ref name="SoR" />
